news.headline: Poland braces for tense week after deadly Krakow shooting deepens political divisions
news.summary: Poland faces a week of political tensions after its deadliest shooting in decades left six people dead and dozens wounded in Krakow on Saturday. The attack has heightened concerns over rising far-right extremism ahead of a major nationalist march.
